stem: Based on the selection, why is the title “More Than a Whistle” appropriate?

options.label: A
options.text: El Silbo is a whistled language produced with specialized sounds.

options.label: B
options.text: El Silbo is a whistled language, but it also represents a traditional way of life in La Gomera.

options.label: C
options.text: El Silbo is a language that uses whistles of different pitches, but it is used less often than it once was.

options.label: D
options.text: El Silbo is a whistled language that can be heard over long distances.
